title: StockReserved
description: Reply (ADR 0006). Published by inventory-service through its outbox (aggregateType=StockReservation, key=orderId). Consumed by order-service, which deduplicates by (orderId, causationId, eventType) and saga state. Every line is held until expiresAt. A StockReserved re-published for a duplicate reserve repeats the outcome of the original reserve; the lines may have changed since (confirmed, released, expired), which their own replies reported.

merchantId.description: Owner of the order's store. inventory scopes every read and write by merchantId + storeId.

orderId.description: Saga id and Kafka key; one order belongs to one store (BR-ORD-01).

causationId.description: eventId of the command this replies to (for a re-published reply: the duplicate command's eventId).

expiresAt.description: Earliest expiry of the order's holds (TTL 15 min by default, BR-INV-02).
